rules.title: Convention over configuration
rules.text: Follow Rails conventions for naming, routing and file layout.

rules.title: Strong parameters
rules.text: Permit parameters explicitly with strong parameters.

rules.title: Service objects
rules.text: Keep controllers thin and move complex logic into service objects.

rules.title: Avoid N+1
rules.text: Use includes to avoid N+1 queries and add database indexes for foreign keys.
